New built-up land came from: vegetation 91%, agriculture 6%, water 3%, bare soil 1%.

Read with care. A 5-channel U-Net trained on Dynamic World labels classified two Sentinel-2 composites (Jan to Mar of each year, 10 m). Checked against 149 hand-labeled points in Kochi (2024 only), it matched 93% of them; Dynamic World matched 90%. Change between years has not been checked by hand. Net change is the more reliable number. Built-up loss (not drawn) and part of the gross gain come from bare, dry ground read as built-up, not from demolition. Vegetation includes scrub and open land.
